default_policy: unchanged: full jax.clear_caches before Polynomial registry eviction
opt_in: preserve_dispatch_cache=True with low_memory=True on EncryptedPolynomialEvaluator or CompiledArithmetic
guard: Preserve ordinary dispatch caches only when Polynomial registry is empty; otherwise perform prior full JAX clear before clearing registry.
scope_constraints: Dedicated serial evaluator process, fixed public circuit/device/layout/level set.
All synchronization and explicit binding/control/key/plaintext/level/registry eviction remain enabled.
Session shutdown and original Bootstrap stage JAX clears remain unchanged.
No generic guarantee for user code that mutates the registry or races JAX transforms concurrently.
Object weakrefs/backing lifetime does not measure total HBM, executable memory, allocator retention or accelerator performance.
No transformer end-to-end or calibrated timing claim; existing skipped secure polynomial suites are not claimed passing.
